title: Post-merge resilience scratchpad and mini-experiments
body:
Context:
- Working notes for small, fast experiments to reduce post-merge fragility in the serving-runtime surface (particularly around KV cache warmup, small-batch path, and fallback routing).
- Purpose: capture short heuristics, quick checklists, and tiny follow-ups that are easy to slot into PRs or skunkworks spikes. Not a formal plan.

Quick post-merge checklist (to keep in PR description):
- Canary plan: who is on-call for the hour after merge, and what metric defines rollback (p50 latency + error rate).
- Low-risk smoke: run single-node smoke deploy with synthetic load for 60s before rolling to cluster.
- Observability hooks: ensure a short-lived trace/span tag is emitted (tag:pr_shortname=<PR>) so we can search traces easily.
- Assert toggles: add a feature flag gate for new KV strategy or micro-refactor (exp gate name: pr_xxx_kv_gate).
- Quick rollback: attach exact rollback command snippet to the PR description.

Mini experiments to run post-merge (1h each):
1) KV warmup jitter test
   - Hypothesis: small randomized prefetch windows reduce first-100-token latency spikes for new model keysets.
   - Method: instrument a background prefetch job for 30s after deploy on 10% traffic; compare p95 for the next 5 minutes.
   - Metrics: p50/p95 latency, cache hit ratio, CPU usage on GPU host.

2) Small-batch degradation probe
   - Hypothesis: batching heuristics sometimes increase tail latency for tiny bursts.
   - Method: run micro-bench with 1,2,3 concurrent requests and toggled batching. Capture token generation latency.
   - Quick acceptance: if p95 increases >20% on tiny bursts, revert batching heuristic change.

3) Fallback routing smoke
   - Hypothesis: fallback to smaller-quantized model reduces error rate but may create tokenization mismatches.
   - Method: route 5% of requests to fallback, validate output length distribution and top-level semantic sanity checks (presence of key tokens).

Refactor idea catalog (tiny, low-blast changes):
- Break out a single responsibility: move the KV prefetch jitter calc into a tiny util with explicit unit tests (no infra change).
- Add a lightweight end-to-end test that runs through the routing decision tree with mocked capacity responses. Keep it <30s.
- Replace implicit magic constant (0.7) in batching logic with named constant and add doc comment + unit tests for boundary cases.

Observability/telemetry anchors I want in short term:
- Short-lived 'pr_id' tag on traces + a counter metric pr_validation.failures (labels: step, pr_id).
- Export a small histogram for token-generation micro-latencies per model-variant.
- Alert rule: if pr_validation.failures{step=kv_warmup} > 5 in 10m, page.

Follow-ups / tickets to open from this scratchpad:
- INF-XXXX: lightweight e2e routing test harness (owner: Maya)
- INF-XXXX: add pr_id trace tag + short-lived counter (owner: Rafael)
- INF-XXXX: small-batch micro-benchmark script and dashboard (owner: Omar)

Notes to self / heuristics for when to push a hotfix vs revert:
- If functional correctness is compromised (invalid outputs, tokenization loss) => revert immediately.
- If only tail latency regressions and we have a short-term mitigation (e.g., disable new batching) => hotfix toggle and observe for 30m.
- If increases in CPU/GPU are steady and grow costs >10% of baseline => prioritize revert unless compensated by throughput improvements.

Open questions / things to check quickly:
- Does the new KV prefetch interact poorly with certain tokenizer versions? Quick run: sample top-10 tokenizers from integration test suite.
- Any hidden back-compat problems with existing ML infra metrics collectors when we add a pr_id tag? Check telemetry ingestion limits.

Next steps (short):
- Slot a 1h lab session tomorrow morning to add pr_id tag + counter. Push as a tiny PR; include smoke plan.
- Draft the three INF tickets with minimal reproduction steps and link to this doc.
- When landing changes, paste the quick checklist into the PR template under the 'post-merge' section.

Random quick heuristics (notes to self):
- Prefer feature flags that default off for anything touching KV paths unless owner signs off.
- Keep experiment windows < 1 hour for any production probe to limit blast radius.
- Use synthetic requests that are representative of real token length distribution (copy from latency-dashboard sample set).

——
Timestamped scratch lines (for personal use):
- 2024-07-12 10:03: first sketch of KV jitter idea, seems promising.
- 2024-07-12 13:40: noticed batching constant magic number. Add todo in PR.
- 2024-11-05 09:22: ran tiny canary; p95 improved slightly on one run but noisy. Need repeated sample.
- 2025-01-20 15:10: confirmed telemetry ingestion handles pr_id tag at our expected cardinality (spot check).

End.
